body:

What degraded

  • The deck shipped at the round cap, 7.088 against the 7.7 rung. The largest drag is artwork_craft (6.0 to 6.6): the three interiors on frames 4, 5 and 8 sit outside the storm world, and frame 6's 33 heads read as one bar at feed size.
  • The caption's close was rewritten after the panel scored it, because ledger_check refused the room's close as the same substance as the September 27th deck. The judges read the earlier close.
  • Phase 1, the craft refresh, was skipped for time.
  • tx-2026-0088 stays unreachable. Brazos County answers 403 and kbtx.com disallows ClaudeBot, so it keeps its old stamp.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The Watchtower, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

The answer was filed on May 1st.

In July 2025 the PUCT approved the resiliency plan of Southwestern Public Service, Xcel Energy's utility across most of the Texas Panhandle. Its order lists the "number of artificial intelligence camera fire detections" among the agreed metrics for each annual report.

SPS's report answered that line with "33 cameras installed" and 34 projected for 2026. It does count 24 ignitions associated with overhead power lines and 26 wildfires reported in counties SPS serves. SPS says a partial year can't yet show effectiveness against projections.

What that line lacks is one number, the count of detections the order named.

SPS says its 2027 annual report will carry a full year of data, and under the order it carries the same line.

Will that report count fire detections, or cameras again?

#TexasPanhandle #PUCT #XcelEnergy

2. The first comment

The machine changed itself

  • wildfire_camera_station and pipe_rail_fence lifted into the kit (assets/js/kit/power.js, rural.js) with a rebuilt camera head: a hooded housing with a lens behind glass on a pan saddle
    All three round 5 judges named the chassis heads as box primitives that read as floodlights or a comb of T shapes at feed size
  • The kit mesa's strata texture and rim noise rebuilt (assets/js/kit/landscape.js): beds 1.5 m tall, per-surface mapping, rim noise that closes on itself
    Judges in rounds 3 to 5 named stretched terraced striations and a jagged cutoff at the mesa's right end on six frames
  • ENGINE PROPOSAL FOR A MAINTAINER: stormFront in assets/js/txthree.js from fogDensity 0.0065 to 0.0028 and envIntensity 0.45 to 0.75 (human lane, in UPGRADE_BACKLOG.md)
    At 0.0065 the plain is 61 percent fogged at 150 m and 98 percent at 300 m, the white wall three critics named. This deck declared the fix in its chassis

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

The record. Three items were due. Frontera's queue closing (tx-2026-0125) and the NSF node at Texas Southern (tx-2026-0175) were re-read on their own sources and stamped. Brazos County's RELLIS item (tx-2026-0088) stays unreachable: the county answers 403 and kbtx.com disallows ClaudeBot, so it keeps its old stamp. Seven stale crawl-boundary blocks came off because those hosts answer again. Admitted. tx-2026-0191, the PUCT's wildfire mitigation plan blueprint, which marks cameras as a suggested tool and not a requirement. tx-2026-0192, the order approving SPS's resiliency plan, which lists AI camera fire detections among the agreed metrics, against SPS's May 1st annual report, which answered that line with 33 cameras installed and no count of detections. Both rest on the commission's own filings. Held. The Tribune's 97 cameras (a service territory count, not a Texas one) and Xcel's Colorado camera statements stay off every surface. The deck. Five panel rounds, medians 6.564, 6.852, 7.006, 7.13 and 7.088, and no hard fail in any round. The panel moved the framing to what the order says (a metric the parties agreed, never the state asking), scoped the wildfire plan rule as a different rule, and turned "had complied" into "had filed" with the director's own breakdown. Frame 2 was recomposed twice before it read as a photograph. The caption's close was rewritten after scoring because the ledger refused a repeated closing substance. Instrument check and discoverability signoff all passed. The article page and the front page were opened at phone width and read correctly. Prompt audit (interim, Phase 17): 1,592 calls measured, 481 with permission decisions of 1.0 to 4.6 seconds, none longer. The no-stall hook was armed at 06:25:45 UTC, judged the session unattended from the start (host CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0), refused nothing, and nothing waited on it. The final reading is taken just before this draft.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
